museum: Museum of Mediterranean and Near Eastern Antiquities (Medelhavsmuseet)

possible_additional_holdings: Unidentified linen bundles/animal-mummy fragments X-rayed 2012 with contents not stated online (MM 11006, MM 30794, MM 30795, MM 30796, NME 794) - no evidence they contain crocodile; linen wrapping removed from MME 1983:013 A kept at Etnografiska museet cold room box MM:1 (per DB). notes: 22 distinct crocodile mummies/parts: mostly hatchlings/juveniles (Retzius collection MM 18406-18415; Otto Smith gift MM 10133-10134 L. 99 and 90.8 cm; B. Cronstrand 1842 via Nationalmuseum/Riksmuseet NME 797, MME 1983:013 A). Most not on display are recorded as 'Loan out / Current 0000.0006' to Etnografiska museet (SMVK storage). MM 10134 currently on loan to Östergötlands museum, Linköping (loan 2020.0005). Exhibition 'Egypten' 2014-, showcase 8.4 'Mummified young crocodiles'. Provenance recorded only as 'Egypt'.

notes: One partial crocodile hatchling mummy (front part), gift 1865, formerly in the ethnographic collection (code 'etn').
